text:
Alex Kim: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem (PM-1265). We still have pending remediation items for the token-ingest delay that caused ~3 days of delayed usage and a small set of incorrect invoices. Who's owning what and when?
Maya Patel: I'll own the ingest backfill and validation. Plan to run a dry-run on a small time window today, full reprocess by EOD Friday if dry-run looks good. Need infra snapshot + low-traffic window.
Liam Chen: @Maya I can provide the DB snapshot and reserve a maintenance window. Snapshot will be ready in ~2h. I'll also own orchestration of the reprocess job.
Sam Ortiz: Finance needs a machine-readable list of affected invoices so we can calculate credit amounts and prepare ledger adjustments. Prefer CSV with columns: customer_id, invoice_id, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, delta, reason.
Zoe Martinez: Support can prepare a customer-facing note and internal playbook once we have the final list. We'll hold comms until corrections are staged.
Maya Patel: Backfill plan (high level):
- dry-run: subset window (2026-04-08T00:00 to 2026-04-08T03:00)
- run reconciliation scripts against ledger to compute deltas
- if dry-run OK, schedule full backfill during maintenance window
- stage invoice corrections for finance approval before issuing credits
I'll post checksums and a validation summary in this thread after dry-run.
billing-bot: Invoice correction job queued: job_id=job-8873 status=queued (automated)
Liam Chen: Reprocess invocation (example):
```
# run on k8s in dedicated namespace
kubectl -n billing run reprocess-backfill --image=redwood/backfill:prod -- 
  --start=2026-04-08T00:00 --end=2026-04-11T23:59 --snapshot=snap-176952 --mode=dry-run
```
Maya Patel: Validation checklist I'll use after dry-run:
- token delta per customer computed and non-negative
- aggregated token totals match expected ledger delta within tolerance
- sample of 10 invoices manually verified
- backfill job logs uploaded to S3 for audit (s3://redwood-incidents/pm-1265/)
Sam Ortiz: Finance approval gate: CSV + aggregation checks + 2 sample invoice verifications. I'll sign off if all pass; will prepare credit entries once approved.
Zoe Martinez: I'll draft the customer message and FAQ now and keep it in a private doc until we decide to send.
Alex Kim: TL;DR action items: 
- Maya: dry-run today, post results + checksum by 18:00 PT
- Liam: provide snapshot (~2h) and kick off dry-run job
- Sam: prepare CSV template and be ready to review results
- Zoe: draft comms and FAQ (hold until staging)
We'll use this thread as the single source of truth for results and approvals. If any owner needs to reassign, mention @alex or @sam. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
